objective.text: Distinguish container-resolved Form Requests from direct construction when testing automatic validation.

difficulty.rationale: Exercise the framework resolution hook instead of assuming a constructor invokes validation.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A unit test only executes new SignupRequest() and sees no ValidationException despite missing required email. The request rules are correct. What must the test exercise to verify Laravel's automatic validation workflow?

options.text: Resolve the request through Laravel's configured container or send an HTTP request to an action that type-hints it.
options.rationale: Automatic validation is attached to container resolution of ValidatesWhenResolved objects; plain construction does not invoke that hook.

options.text: Call json_encode on the new request before checking for an exception.
options.rationale: Serialization does not run the Form Request resolution hook.
options.misconception: Serialization does not run the Form Request resolution hook.

options.text: Make email a public property so construction discovers its rule.
options.rationale: Validation rules are not triggered by declaring matching public properties.
options.misconception: Validation rules are not triggered by declaring matching public properties.

options.text: Assert that plain construction throws and keep the same setup.
options.rationale: The constructor is not the framework validation lifecycle entry point.
options.misconception: The constructor is not the framework validation lifecycle entry point.
